verses.english: Numbered Discourses 3.118
12. Bound for Loss
Sure-bet Dice
“Mendicants, there are three failures.
What three?
Failure in ethics, mind, and view.
And what is failure in ethics?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti …pe… samphappalāpī hoti.
verses.english: It’s when someone kills living creatures, steals, commits sexual misconduct, and uses speech that’s false, backbiting, harsh, or nonsensical.
This is called ‘failure in ethics’.
And what is failure in mind?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco abhijjhālu hoti byāpannacitto.
verses.english: It’s when someone is covetous and malicious.
This is called ‘failure in mind’.
And what is failure in view?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco micchādiṭṭhiko hoti viparītadassano:
verses.english: It’s when someone has wrong view, a distorted perspective, such as:

verses.pali: ‘natthi dinnaṁ, natthi yiṭṭhaṁ …pe… ye imañca lokaṁ parañca lokaṁ sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
verses.english: ‘There’s no meaning in giving, sacrifice, or offerings. There’s no fruit or result of good and bad deeds. There’s no afterlife. There’s no such thing as mother and father, or beings that are reborn spontaneously. And there’s no ascetic or brahmin who is rightly comported and rightly practiced, and who describes the afterlife after realizing it with their own insight.’
This is called ‘failure in view’.

verses.pali: Sīlavipattihetu vā, bhikkhave …pe… diṭṭhivipattihetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā apāyaṁ duggatiṁ vinipātaṁ nirayaṁ upapajjanti.
verses.english: Some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell because of failure in ethics, mind, or view.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, apaṇṇako maṇi uddhaṁ khitto yena yeneva patiṭṭhāti suppatiṭṭhitaṁyeva patiṭṭhāti;
verses.english: It’s like throwing sure-bet dice: they always fall the right side up.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, sīlavipattihetu vā sattā …pe… upapajjanti.
verses.english: In the same way, some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a place of loss, a bad place, the underworld, hell because of failure in ethics, mind, or view.
These are the three failures.
There are three accomplishments.
What three?
Accomplishment in ethics, mind, and view.
And what is accomplishment in ethics?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti …pe…
verses.english: It’s when someone doesn’t kill living creatures, steal, commit sexual misconduct, or use speech that’s false, backbiting, harsh, or nonsensical.
This is called accomplishment in ethics.
And what is accomplishment in mind?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco anabhijjhālu hoti abyāpannacitto.
verses.english: It’s when someone is content and kind-hearted.
This is called accomplishment in mind.
And what is accomplishment in view?

verses.pali: Idha, bhikkhave, ekacco sammādiṭṭhiko hoti aviparītadassano:
verses.english: It’s when someone has right view, an undistorted perspective, such as:

verses.pali: ‘atthi dinnaṁ, atthi yiṭṭhaṁ …pe… ye imañca lokaṁ parañca lokaṁ sayaṁ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentī’ti.
verses.english: ‘There is meaning in giving, sacrifice, and offerings. There are fruits and results of good and bad deeds. There is an afterlife. There are such things as mother and father, and beings that are reborn spontaneously. And there are ascetics and brahmins who are rightly comported and rightly practiced, and who describe the afterlife after realizing it with their own insight.’
This is called accomplishment in view.

verses.pali: Sīlasampadāhetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjanti. Cittasampadāhetu vā …pe… diṭṭhisampadāhetu vā, bhikkhave, sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjanti.
verses.english: Some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm because of accomplishment in ethics, mind, or view.

verses.pali: Seyyathāpi, bhikkhave, apaṇṇako maṇi uddhaṁ khitto yena yeneva patiṭṭhāti suppatiṭṭhitaṁyeva patiṭṭhāti;
verses.english: It’s like throwing sure-bet dice: they always fall the right side up.

verses.pali: evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, sīlasampadāhetu vā sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjanti, cittasampadāhetu vā sattā …pe… diṭṭhisampadāhetu vā sattā kāyassa bhedā paraṁ maraṇā sugatiṁ saggaṁ lokaṁ upapajjanti.
verses.english: In the same way, some sentient beings, when their body breaks up, after death, are reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm because of accomplishment in ethics, mind, or view.
These are the three accomplishments.”
